jobs.description_text: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

jobs.title: Training Manager, Ukraine (R5747)
jobs.description_text: Job Description: The Ukraine Training Manager is responsible for the leadership, management, and execution of Shield AI's V-BAT customer training program supporting Ukraine. This position oversees all aspects of training operations, ensuring instruction is delivered safely, effectively, and in accordance with approved Programs of Instruction (POIs) while meeting contractual requirements and customer expectations. The Ukraine Training Manager serves as the primary operational liaison for all Ukraine training activities, providing oversight of instructor staffing, personnel readiness, aircraft availability, student progression, and day-to-day course execution. Working closely with the Ukraine Senior Manager, Fleet Support, Curriculum Development, Engineering, Security, Program Management, and the customer, this individual identifies operational risks, develops personnel courses of action, and ensures training teams have the resources required to accomplish the mission. This role is responsible for developing and standardizing the Ukraine instructor cadre while continuously improving course delivery, student outcomes, and operational effectiveness. Location & Deployment: This role is based in Dallas, TX and will initially support an extended deployment to Ukraine. Once the deployment is complete, the role will be based in Dallas, and relocation will be required for anyone not already local to the area.

jobs.title: Advanced Product and Solutions Lead
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Advanced Product and Solutions Lead will play a key role in technical customer engagements by managing product customization requests and elaborating detailed technical content, across both commercial and defense segments. The Lead will work with customer engagement teams, including Customer Solutions and Sales Engineering, to translate advanced customer needs into Lightspeed deliverables and provide advanced support to customers and partners (e.g. technical deep dives). The role sits within the Product Management organization for Telesat Lightspeed and works closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, Customer Solutions, Operations and ecosystem partners. The role will work across the range of products and solutions offered by Lightspeed, including connectivity services, value-added services, security services, private infrastructure offerings, user terminals, and third-party integrations. This role requires strong technical depth, strong solutioning skills, a product mindset, and the ability to translate customer and market needs into scalable, commercially viable services. Resource is expected to be onsite at Telesat HQ, a minimum of 4 days per week.

jobs.title: Analyst, IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking a highly motivated and collaborative professional to support the cybersecurity compliance activities of the Telesat Lightspeed program. The successful candidate will be responsible for assessing and monitoring the implementation of cybersecurity controls across Lightspeed systems and processes, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory, contractual, and certification requirements. This role will work closely with Engineering, Operations, IT, and business stakeholders to obtain evidence of control implementation, track remediation activities, identify compliance gaps, and provide ongoing assurance of cybersecurity readiness. The candidate will play a key role in coordinating compliance initiatives, maintaining program visibility, supporting assessments and audits, and helping ensure continued readiness for frameworks and certifications such as CMMC, IA-Pre, and other applicable industry standards.

jobs.title: Data Management Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Telesat LEO Lightspeed Data Management Specialist will report to the Lightspeed Manager, Configuration Management & Change Control. The Telesat LEO Lightspeed Data Management Specialist will be responsible for the log, capture, processing and release of both internal and contractor delivered Telesat LEO Lightspeed documentation. The Data Management Specialist will support the Document & Data Management Specialist with the end-to-end processing of LEO Lightspeed Program data and documentation as well as other related activities required to support the Lightspeed work. The Document and Data Management Specialist will require a good working knowledge of document and data management processes and procedures with experience working with best practices standards such as CM2, ANSI-EIA 649, and/or ISO 10007 on medium sized systems integration Projects. The Document and Data Management Specialist will also require excellent organizational, language, writing and communication skills with intermediate to advanced proficiency using MS Office products (MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint). The role ensures that all data is accurate, traceable, audit-ready, and aligned with program baselines, supporting the successful delivery of high-reliability, mission-critical space systems.

jobs.title: Document Control Coordinator
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Telesat LEO Lightspeed Document Control Coordinator will report to the Lightspeed Manager, Configuration Management & Change Control. The Document Control Coordinator plays a critical role in supporting mission assurance and program execution within Lightspeed Program. This position is responsible for the controlled management of technical and program documentation throughout its lifecycle, ensuring compliance with aerospace quality standards, configuration management principles, and customer/mission requirements. The Document Control Coordinator will require a good working knowledge of document and data management control processes and procedures with experience working with best practices standards such as CM2, ANSI-EIA 649, or ISO 10007 on complex, large to medium sized systems integration projects. jobs.title: Facilities Technician / Technicien(ne) des installations
jobs.description_text: Télésat (Nasdaq et TSX : TSAT) est un opérateur mondial de satellites de premier plan qui fournit depuis plus de 50 ans des solutions de communication par satellite fiables et sécurisées à des clients du secteur de la radiodiffusion, des télécommunications, des entreprises et des gouvernements. Forte d'une tradition d'excellence en ingénierie, de fiabilité et de service à la clientèle de premier ordre dans le secteur, Télésat est devenue l'un des opérateurs mondiaux de satellites les plus importants et les plus prospères. Telesat Lightspeed, notre réseau révolutionnaire de satellites en orbite basse (LEO), dont la mise en service est prévue en 2027, redéfinira la connectivité mondiale à bande passante pour les utilisateurs professionnels en offrant une capacité, une sécurité et une résilience élevées, ainsi que des prix abordables, avec une latence ultra-faible et des vitesses comparables à celles de la fibre optique. Télésat a son siège social à Ottawa, au Canada, et possède des bureaux et des installations partout dans le monde. Pour en savoir plus, consultez le site www.telesat.com. jobs.description_text: Reporting to the Director, Service Management, the successful candidate will provide technical and team leadership for the testing, quality assurance, release management, and production operations of Lightspeed business and technical applications and platforms. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring high software quality standards throughout the systems development lifecycle and for supporting the operation of Telesat's Lightspeed production and test environments. Working closely with the Platform Engineering, Development, and IT PMO teams, the candidate will help plan, coordinate, and execute testing and production release activities while ensuring alignment with project schedules and operational requirements. The successful candidate will develop and maintain performance metrics, analyze results and trends, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Candidates must reside in the Ottawa area or be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance will be provided to qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator - PLM Implementation
jobs.description_text: We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Project Coordinator to initially support the implementation of a new enterprise Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Reporting to the Program Management Office, the successful candidate will play a key role in coordinating project activities, maintaining governance processes, supporting stakeholder engagement, and ensuring project information is accurate, current, and accessible. This position is ideal for an individual with 3-6 years of project coordination or PMO support experience who thrives in cross-functional environments and enjoys bringing structure, organization, and accountability to complex business and technology initiatives.

jobs.title: Security System Architect
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Security System Architect to secure next-generation satellite systems and support ground infrastructure. Reporting to the Senior Director, System Architecture and Release Train, you will lead the integration of cybersecurity across the product lifecycle, ensuring security is embedded from concept and design through deployment and operations. As a member of the System Architecture team, as the Security Champion you will work closely with Segment Domain Architects, engineering teams, and Product Cybersecurity stakeholders to ensure cybersecurity requirements are effectively incorporated into system architectures and product designs. Acting as the bridge between system architecture and cybersecurity, you will champion secure-by-design principles, assess cyber risks, and guide architectural decisions that enhance the resilience and security of space, ground, network, and cloud-based systems.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Canada Defence — Client & Program (ESCPP)
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for an exceptional Senior Director to be the single face of this program from Telesat to DND – owning the customer relationship and orchestrating delivery from build through to operational service. If you are energized by high-stakes defence programs, thrive at the intersection of customer, commercial and engineering, and want to help shape a nation’s strategic communications capability, this is a rare and career-defining role. This is as much a technical and program-delivery leadership role as it is a customer role: you will bring genuine engineering fluency and deep program management discipline to steer a complex, multi-segment space and ground system from build through to in-service operation.

As the delivery lead for the Core UT segment, the role provides execution visibility, dependency management, release readiness, and milestone status into the broader Lightspeed Solution Train, ensuring alignment with solution-level objectives, Program Increment commitments, and release plans. This role focuses on engineering execution leadership and delivery coordination rather than direct people management, product ownership, project management, or architectural decision-making.

In addition to delegating assignments and managing the execution, the Senior Manager will serve as a technical liaison to guide implementation, ensuring compliance with Telesat’s operational standards. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management Office
jobs.description_text: Position Summary The Senior Manager, Project Management Office (PMO) reports to the Director of Mission Assurance and Program Integration and is responsible for leading enterprise program governance, integrated schedule and budget planning, program controls, portfolio reporting, and cross-segment coordination for complex telecommunications and space programs. This role provides the framework, tools, processes, and oversight necessary to enable successful program delivery across multiple organizational segments while ensuring executive leadership has clear visibility into program performance, risks, dependencies, milestones, and strategic objectives. The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where not all processes, standards, and organizational interfaces have been fully established, and where success requires building structure, alignment, and operational discipline across multiple stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Trainer, Instructional Design & Training
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for a highly skilled and motivated Senior Trainer, Instructional Design & Training to join our team, reporting directly to the GTM PMO & Business Operations Head. In this senior role, you will lead the design, development, and delivery of high-quality training programs and enablement materials for Telesat’s Business Support System (BSS) and the Canadian Department of National Defence (DND) customer under the Enhanced Satellite Communication Project (ESCP) — a major contract award. You will be accountable for the full training deliverable set, spanning the BSS, LEO Mission and Network Operations training and User Terminal (UT) operations and field maintenance training, translating complex technical content into structured, self-paced, and instructor-led curricula that meet Canada’s accessibility, format, and Learning Management System requirements. If you are a proactive learning professional with a passion for building operational readiness and a proven track record delivering training in demanding, mission-critical defence environments, we encourage you to apply and help us achieve our strategic goals.

The TCC technologist proactively monitors network services and fixed satellite service customers, and manages the troubleshooting and investigation of reported faults until services have been restored. They perform hands-on corrective and preventative measures to Allan Park earth station critical systems, TT&C ground communications equipment, and on-site customer services.

jobs.description_text: The Technical Program Integration Lead serves as the focal point for integrated planning and execution within a major program segment, product area, or technical domain This role bridges technical complexity and program execution by transforming multiple engineering, product, software, hardware, operations, integration, and supplier workstreams into a cohesive, executable, and measurable program plan. Working across technical teams, systems engineering, program management, and program controls organizations, the Senior Technical Program Integration Lead ensures scope, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, and delivery commitments are accurately represented within the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and broader program framework Unlike a traditional Project Manager or Integrated Program Controls Analysts, this role drives technical planning maturity, cross-functional alignment, and execution discipline while ensuring technical teams operate as a fully integrated part of the overall program The role is accountable for establishing and maintaining a credible, integrated execution plan, identifying, and proposing workarounds and mitigations for risks and dependencies early, and enabling leadership to make informed decisions based on clear assessments of program readiness and execution health Success in this position requires strong technical acumen, systems-level thinking, and the ability to influence diverse stakeholders toward a common execution strategy

The successful candidate will be responsible for transforming complex technical information into clear, structured documentation suitable for engineering teams, suppliers, integrators, manufacturing partners, and internal stakeholders. The role will help refine documentation standards, improve document quality, manage document reviews, and ensure requirements traceability across the UT product portfolio.

jobs.title: User Terminal Program Manager, Mil-Ka
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: As User Terminal (UT) Program Manager, Mil-Ka, this position will join the User Terminal development team responsible for the development, integration, qualification, delivery, and deployment of Mil-Ka user terminal solutions supporting Telesat Lightspeed government and defence programs. The UT Program Manager, Mil-Ka will lead the programmatic execution of external vendor terminal development programs and serve as a primary interface between Telesat and its user terminal suppliers. The role will coordinate closely with Telesat engineering, product management, systems engineering, PMO, procurement, contracts, and other stakeholders to ensure terminal solutions meet technical, schedule, cost, quality, and program objectives. This role requires a seasoned program manager with demonstrated experience managing complex satellite communications or similar hardware/software development programs through design, integration, verification, manufacturing readiness, delivery, and deployment. Experience developing satellite communications equipment or user terminals for government, defence, or other mission-critical applications is highly desirable. Success in this role requires a proactive, results-driven program manager with a high degree of initiative and strong communication skills, able to drive execution across cross-functional organizations and external suppliers while operating effectively in a complex government program environment.

At Lyft, Telematics data is used to make Lyft safer by reducing the frequency and severity of accidents, which in turn also makes Lyft more affordable for riders and a better way to earn a living for drivers. The Telematics team acts as a platform team that processes petabytes of mobile sensor data — millisecond-level IMU, gyroscope, and GPS signals — through a series of DAG-based transformations and ML model inferences to detect harsh driving events and convert them into normalized risk features that other Lyft services consume. Our technology stack runs on AWS, Kubernetes, Spark, and Apache Airflow. In this role, you'll work closely with data scientists, actuarial teams, other backend and data engineers, and product management — partnering across geos to build risk-aware products that rank and reward safe drivers, help off-board unsafe ones, notify drivers in real time, and give claims agents the tools to understand exactly what happened in a ride. You'll also be a key technical partner to our insurance team as they optimize coverage costs and provider relationships. If you are a seasoned engineer with a passion for innovation, high-volume data pipelines, microservices, working in cross-disciplinary environments and possess the skills to ensure the ongoing maintenance and improvement of services, you will thrive on our team! jobs.title: 車両テストエンジニア・AD/ADAS Application
jobs.description_text: ウーブン・バイ・トヨタについて ウーブン・バイ・トヨタは、トヨタの100年に一度のモビリティ・カンパニーへの変革に寄与していきます。「自分以外の誰かのために」発明を続けたという歴史からインスピレーションを受けた私たちのミッションーそれは、モビリティの定義を拡げ、そしてモビリティが社会に貢献する方法を拡張し、人を想うイノベーションで、モビリティの常識に挑み続けることです。 私たちは4つの柱を中心に活動しています：自動運転・先進運転支援システム技術のAD/ADAS、SDV（ソフトウェア定義車両）のための車両ソフトウェア生産プラットフォームであるArene、モビリティのテストコースであるWoven City、そして協業基盤を支えるデジタル・インフラストラクチャのCloud & AIです。また、ビジネスに不可欠な機能がこれらのチームの実装を下支えし、一丸となって「事故ゼロ社会」と「幸せの量産」の実現に向けて取り組んでいます。 ========================================================================= チームについて Teammate Driving (POV BEV) チームは、自動運転システムにおける最も基本的な機能の1つである車線維持機能と、自動運転システムで使用される地図情報提供サービスを開発しています。テストエンジニアのミッションは、システム要件に基づいて実装されたソフトウェアの機能、性能、品質基準を設定し、評価し、設計者にフィードバックし、製品の性能と品質を向上させることです。また、これらの製品をトヨタの次世代運転支援システム「Toyota Safety Sense」と「Teammate」に実装し、世界中の顧客により安全な運転とより快適なモビリティを提供します。 求める人材 私たちは、ソフトウェアのパフォーマンスと品質を向上させるために、AD/ADAS車両評価の運用と問題分析を行い、問題解決を推進できるエンジニアを探しています。また、ソフトウェアエンジニア、テストドライバ、さまざまな協力者と良好な関係を築くために、新しい価値を提案し、効果的にコミュニケーションできる人材を求めています。尚、定期的に東京・日本橋のオフィスに出社し、静岡県東富士のテストコースで実地試験の実施が必要となります。 業務内容 プロジェクトの進捗状況に合わせた評価計画の策定と管理 システム要件を満たすテストシナリオの作成 実車でのテストと特定された問題の原因の特定 アジャイル開発における問題管理と解決の推進 必須条件 以下のスキルと経験が必要です。 ・技術 ・車両評価業務 ・ユーザー視点でソフトウェア要件が満たされていることを検証する能力 ・Gitによるソフトウェア管理能力 ・AD（自動運転）/ADAS（先進運転支援システム）に関する知識と各技術の相互作用の理解 ・管理 ・優れた問題解決能力、仮説検証能力、タスク管理能力 ・ドキュメンテーション能力 ・さまざまな情報を体系化し、首尾一貫した計画を立案する能力 ・言語 ・日常的な場面で使われる日本語を理解できる能力。（例：日本語能力試験N2以上、または同等のレベル）

You will write the backend that sits between a partner and our commerce platform — link generation, click and conversion tracking, attribution pass-through, postbacks, and the reporting endpoints that feed partner payouts. You will also build the internal tooling that lets the Partnerships and Customer Success teams onboard partners and reconcile payouts without hand-editing spreadsheets. This is an entry-level engineering role with genuine product surface area. Recent graduates and career-changers with a strong project portfolio are welcome. If you like small, well-scoped systems that other people depend on daily, and you want to learn commerce, attribution, and payments engineering from a team that runs it at global scale, we would love to hear from you. jobs.description_text: About Xsolla Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer | Kimchi (LLM Inference Optimization)
jobs.description_text: About the role Throughput. Latency. KV cache utilization. Move those three numbers in the right direction, and two things happen: customers get faster, cheaper inference, and our margins improve. That's the entire thesis of this role. Every kernel you tune, every quantization scheme you ship, every scheduler tweak you land shows up directly in a customer's p99 and on our P&L. This is a high-impact seat. It is also a high-autonomy seat as you'll be given the room to lead the technical direction of inference optimization at Kimchi, not execute someone else's roadmap. The problem: running LLMs in production is a moving target. The "right" model and serving configuration for a workload depend on traffic shape, sequence-length distribution, batch dynamics, GPU SKU, memory bandwidth, quantization tolerance, and a dozen other variables that shift week to week. Most teams pick a model once, over-provision GPUs, and absorb the cost. Kimchi is the system that makes that decision automatically - continuously matching workloads to the most cost-efficient, best-performing LLM and serving configuration on a customer's infrastructure. We're building the optimization layer between the model and the hardware, and we need engineers who understand both sides deeply. Stack Python; vLLM; SGLang; TensorRT-LLM; PyTorch; CUDA-adjacent tooling; Kubernetes; gRP; ClickHouse; PostgreSQL; GCP Pub/Sub; AWS / GCP / Azure; GitLab CI; ArgoCD; Prometheus; Grafana; Loki; Tempo. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling. Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required. jobs.title: Research Scientist, Foundation Model (World Model & Site Memory)
jobs.description_text: The Role You will own the research question at the centre of LEA, our foundation model of the physical world: can a model learn what normally happens on a site, by place, hour and weather, so that an anomaly is simply what it did not expect? The first version is a probabilistic memory of each site. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Our robots and cameras run on live security sites around the clock, and every event is kept with its clip, the model's verdict and the operator's outcome. That record is your dataset. You will work alongside our perception and model engineers, and your results go into production, not only into papers. What You'll Work On Site memory: a learned, probabilistic model of each site: which people, vehicles and robots are where, at what hour, in what weather, and how the scene usually unfolds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. jobs.title: DevOps Engineer

Wir suchen eine Persönlichkeit, die unsere Managed Services auf das nächste Level hebt. Gemeinsam mit einem kleinen, motivierten Team entwickelst du Automatisierungs- und Plattformlösungen, welche die standardisierte und sichere Bewirtschaftung unserer Kunden- Tenants ermöglichen. Dabei denkst du Prozesse konsequent zu Ende, eliminierst manuelle Tätigkeiten und schaffst nachhaltige Automatisierung mit Code. Dafür stehst du am Morgen auf: Du automatisierst unsere Managed Services und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter. Du baust CI/CD-Pipelines auf und optimierst diese für die automatische Bereitstellung und Bewirtschaftung von Kunden-Tenants. Du entwickelst Automatisierungslösungen mit PowerShell und setzt Infrastructure as Code mit Terraform um. Du integrierst und automatisierst Microsoft Cloud Services über die Microsoft Graph API. Du konzipierst und implementierst Identity- und Access-Management-Lösungen auf Basis von Microsoft Entra ID. Du standardisierst Abläufe, reduzierst manuelle Aktivitäten und schaffst wiederverwendbare Plattformkomponenten. Du arbeitest eng mit Architekten und Engineers zusammen und bringst eigene Ideen aktiv ein.
